blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Use the remainder theorem to find the remainder when the first polynomial is divided by the second polynomial: \(x^{2} + 5x + 6\), \(x - 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Sawal khud bata raha hai ke remainder theorem istemal karna hai, is liye lambi long division ki zaroorat nahi.
Diya kya hai? Polynomial \(f(x) = x^{2} + 5x + 6\) aur divisor \(x - 2\).
Find kya karna hai? Sirf remainder; quotient nahi poocha gaya.
Plan: divisor ko \(x - a\) ki shakal mein likh kar \(a\) pehchanna, phir \(f(a)\) nikalna; yahi remainder hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^{2} + 5x + 6\), divisor \(x - 2\).
Humein find karna hai: remainder.
Tareeqa: Remainder theorem: agar \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se divide karein to remainder \(f(a)\) hota hai. Yeh theorem is liye kaam karta hai ke \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x) + R\); \(x = a\) rakhne se pehla hissa zero ho jata hai aur sirf \(R\) bachta hai. Is se poori long division ki mehnat bach jati hai.

Divisor ko \(x - a\) ki shakal mein dekhein
\[x - 2 = x - a\]
\[a = 2\]
Kyun: Remainder theorem aur factor theorem dono divisor \(x - a\) ke liye bayan kiye gaye hain. Yahan divisor mein minus ka sign pehle se mojood hai, is liye \(a\) seedha \(2\) hai. Yaani hum \(x\) ki jagah woh value rakhenge jis par divisor zero ho jata hai.

\(f(x)\) mein \(x = 2\) rakhein
\[f(2) = (2)^{2} + 5(2) + 6\]
\[= 4 + 10 + 6\]
\[= 20\]
Kyun: Pehle har power ki value nikalein, phir us ko coefficient se multiply karein, aur aakhir mein sab terms jama karein. Ek waqt mein ek kaam karne se hisaab ki ghalti nahi hoti.

Remainder parhein
\[R = f(2) = 20\]
Kyun: Remainder theorem ke mutabiq \(f(2)\) ki value hi remainder hai. Is ka matlab hai ke agar hum lambi division karte to aakhir mein yahi number bachta. Remainder ek number (constant) hai kyunke divisor ki degree 1 hai, aur remainder ki degree us se kam yani 0 hoti hai.

Tasdeeq: synthetic division se \(x - 2\) par divide karein
\[\begin{array}{r|rrr} 2 & 1 & 5 & 6 \\  &  & 2 & 14 \\ \hline & 1 & 7 & \boxed{20} \end{array}\]
Kyun: Synthetic division mein upar wali line mein coefficients (missing power ke liye 0) aur baayen taraf \(a = 2\) likhte hain. Pehla coefficient neeche utarta hai, phir har dafa neeche wala number \(a\) se multiply ho kar agle column mein jata hai aur jama hota hai. Neeche wali line ka aakhri (box wala) number remainder hai: \(20\), bilkul \(f(2)\) ke barabar. Do alag tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Use the remainder theorem to find the remainder when the first polynomial is divided by the second polynomial: \(x^{3} + 5x^{2} + 6\), \(x + 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Sawal khud bata raha hai ke remainder theorem istemal karna hai, is liye lambi long division ki zaroorat nahi.
Diya kya hai? Polynomial \(f(x) = x^{3} + 5x^{2} + 6\) aur divisor \(x + 1\).
Find kya karna hai? Sirf remainder; quotient nahi poocha gaya.
Plan: divisor ko \(x - a\) ki shakal mein likh kar \(a\) pehchanna, phir \(f(a)\) nikalna; yahi remainder hai.

Divisor ko \(x - a\) ki shakal mein likhein
\[x + 1 = x - (-1)\]
\[a = -1\]
Kyun: Theorem divisor \(x - a\) ke liye hai, yani beech mein minus ka sign chahiye. \(x + 1\) mein plus hai, to hum likhte hain \(x - (-1)\); is tarah \(a = -1\) negative aata hai. Asaan tareeqa: divisor ko zero ke barabar rakh dein, \(x + 1 = 0\) se \(x = -1\); yahi value rakhni hai.
Dhyan dein: \(x + 1\) dekh kar \(a = 1\) le lena sab se aam ghalti hai.

\(f(x)\) mein \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[f(-1) = (-1)^{3} + 5(-1)^{2} + 6\]
\[= -1 + 5 + 6\]
\[= 10\]
Kyun: Negative number ki even power (2, 4) positive aati hai, aur odd power (1, 3) negative rehti hai; jaise \((-2)^2 = 4\) lekin \((-2)^3 = -8\). Pehle har power alag se nikalein, phir coefficient se multiply karein, aur aakhir mein jama karein.

\[R = f(-1) = 10\]
Kyun: Remainder theorem ke mutabiq \(f(-1)\) ki value hi remainder hai. Is ka matlab hai ke agar hum lambi division karte to aakhir mein yahi number bachta. Remainder ek number (constant) hai kyunke divisor ki degree 1 hai, aur remainder ki degree us se kam yani 0 hoti hai.

Tasdeeq: synthetic division se \(x + 1\) par divide karein
\[\begin{array}{r|rrrr} -1 & 1 & 5 & 0 & 6 \\  &  & -1 & -4 & 4 \\ \hline & 1 & 4 & -4 & \boxed{10} \end{array}\]
Kyun: Synthetic division mein upar wali line mein coefficients (missing power ke liye 0) aur baayen taraf \(a = -1\) likhte hain. Pehla coefficient neeche utarta hai, phir har dafa neeche wala number \(a\) se multiply ho kar agle column mein jata hai aur jama hota hai. Neeche wali line ka aakhri (box wala) number remainder hai: \(10\), bilkul \(f(-1)\) ke barabar. Do alag tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya, is liye jawab pakka hai.
